title: Four equivalent formulations of the J-2 property
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives four equivalent formulations of the J-2 property of a Noetherian ring: the property itself, the requirement that finite type domains be J-0, that finite algebras be J-1, and a condition on finite purely inseparable extensions of residue fields. The proof records the easy implications among the conditions, uses the regularity criterion on quotients to derive J-2 from the second condition, and closes the cycle from the fourth condition by embedding a finite type domain in a larger domain whose fraction field is a separable extension of a chosen finite extension, applying J-0 ascent to that larger domain and then J-0 descent to the original one.
